notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
A player has at least three cards in hand.
description:
Cast Windfall from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand, then causing you to draw at least three cards, then create that many Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.
